A letter from the heart

Dear Mom & Dad,

Happy 26th anniversary to our favourite two people.

When we think of love, we think of you. Not just the big celebrations, but the small, everyday ways you care. The ways you show up. The ways you make our family feel like home.

Twenty-six years together is so much more than a number. It is a life you have built, side by side. And we feel lucky to be a part of it.

We hope today reminds you how deeply you are loved, how much you mean to us, and how beautiful your togetherness is.

Here’s to more smiles, more little adventures, and many, many more years of holding on to each other.

With all our love — and moke,
Your Tanvi & Kashvi ♡
